Traveler's Canoe
Wood Carver's Tools
Common
Supplies: 1
1 Day Focused
Light and durable to traverse the wild white rivers and far reaching ocean. 
A thin boat made of a light, buoyant wood with a durable paddle. It holds up to two 
Medium creatures and has a maximum speed of 3 mph, 6 if going downstream. 
The canoe weighs 50 lbs and can be carried overhead to portage over land.

Everflame Pot
Alchemist's Supplies
Common
Supplies: 1
1 Day Focused
A small metal cylinder with a wick, it burns long with a curiously purple flame.
Ever Burning Once lit, the pot stays aflame for 10 days without running out. It 
cannot be doused by water or wind, but can be closed by covering the top spout. 
The dark red 6 inch flame lights a 30 ft. Sphere, and can warm the area similar to 
a campfire, though the cylinder remains cool to the touch.

Golia Paddles [1.]
Leatherworker's Tools
Uncommon
Supplies: 3
2 Days Focused
Fit firmly on one's feet, the paddles allow the wearer to reach new speeds beneath the waves.
The Golia Paddles can be worn over other footwear. 
Natural Swimmer While wearing the Golia Paddles, you gain an additional swim 
speed of 20 ft. This bonus applies even if you doe not possess a natural swim 
speed.  
Vicious Burst As a Bonus Action, the wearer can perform a Dash Action while 
underwater.

Weaver's Tools

1 Day Focused
Warm and cozy threads exude a gentle calmness and amicable peace. 
Bundled Up While wearing the scarf, you have Advantage on Animal Handling 
and Persuasion checks, as well as Disadvantage on Intimidation checks. The

Snare - Variable per Biome
Tinker's Tools
Common
Supplies: 1
1/8 Day Focused
A thin rope loop, attached to a wooden support rod to capture prey. 
Before crafting the Snare, determine which biome it is being set for: Strands, 
Farplains, Fenlands, Wealdwoods or Umbrawells.
Setting the Snare With a Utilize action you can set the snare onto a 5 ft. square 
Trap Space.
Snared Determining what was snared within a 2 day period uses the Snare 
Expedition Table from the biome in which the snare was set in. 
Disarming A Traveler can approach and disarm a snare, allowing it to be reused 
without the need of an ability check.

 Eventide Tent
Leatherworker's Tools
Common
Supplies: 3
1 Day Focused
While dark and uncomfortably musky, the tent offers a quiet and restful night's sleep.
This tent is large enough to house up to 4 Medium creatures, its scent repels most 
creatures and allows for a comfortably uneventful, if a little musky night.
Predators Musk Creatures are naturally repelled by the scent of the tent, unwilling 
to approach within 60 ft. without fighting their own basal instincts. CR 1 Beasts 
and below - Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16, to break through the compulsion and 
approach. CR 2 Beasts and above - Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, to muster the will 
to approach. Apex Predators fear little and do not need to perform this test.

Tides Breath [2.]
Leatherworker's Tools
Uncommon
Supplies: 3
1 Day Focused
While uncomfortable to wear at first, breathing underwater quickly becomes second nature.
Undertide Gills Enables the wearer to breathe underwater as if it was air.  
Daellash Reserves The wearer can hold their breath for up to 10 minutes before 
needing to make a Constitution Saving Throw. After the initial 10 minutes, they 
must make a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw at the end of each subsequent 
minute or gain one level of Exhaustion. If the Saving Throw fails, the wearer can't 
hold their breath, and normal suffocation rules apply.
